lemmas.primary_translation: cannot be claimed / unfortunately, that is the case

definitions.translation: cannot be claimed (lit. a pity to say)

examples.no: det er synd å si at de gjorde oppgaven med glede
examples.en: it cannot be claimed that they did the task with pleasure

examples.no: det er synd å si, men det går ganske dårlig
examples.en: sad to say, things are going quite badly
